d: Dilli ke aitihasik ramlila maidan men 'indiya' gathbandhan ki 'vot bachao, desh bachao' maharaili ke dauran purniya sansad pappu yadav alag hi andaj men najar aae. bihar se sadhu-santon aur samarthakon ke bare jatthe ke sath minto rod se ramlila maidan tak march nikalte hue pappu yadav ne kendr sarkar aur mukhy chunav aayukt ke khilaph jamkar narebaji ki aur tikha hamla bola. dekhie graund jiro se pappu yadav ki yah eksaklusiv riporta.
